title: Essentia Mattress and Hippocrates Highlighted in Forbes

content:
Hippocrates Wellness was excited to be highlighted in Forbes with our partner Essentia for the article "Essentia: The Secret To Making And Marketing The Perfect Mattress".  

The article shares the importance of switching to a non-toxic mattress and how Essentia has worked to spread and promote this message. HHI is currently updating all room mattresses to Essentia so that recovery is promoted while awake at the institute, and while sleeping.

Read the full article from Forbes here!
